name: VentraPop – Coupon Popups, Sale Bars & Store Notices
author: Fahad Aslam

sections.description:
VentraPop helps site owners publish promotional and informational campaigns from the WordPress admin without relying on a page builder.

It is useful for stores that want to highlight an offer, explain shipping terms, add a contact shortcut, or place a message at key points in the buying journey. The plugin works well with WooCommerce, but the overall editing experience stays simple and focused.

What you can create

VentraPop includes dedicated builders for:

  • Coupon Popup for discounts, welcome offers, and time-limited promotions
  • Announcement Bar for sitewide updates and promotional messages
  • Free Shipping Bar for threshold-based shipping reminders
  • Sticky Contact Button for quick access to WhatsApp, phone, email, and similar channels
  • Floating Promo Card for persistent corner offers and reminders
  • Shortcode Message Block for reusable inline content
  • Smart Product Notice for product, cart, checkout, and thank-you placements

Common use cases

Use VentraPop to:

  • welcome first-time shoppers with an offer
  • announce a promotion or shipping update
  • keep a support contact action visible
  • show a floating reminder without interrupting browsing
  • place trust, urgency, or shipping information near purchase actions
  • reuse a message inside content areas with a shortcode

Campaign builders

Each campaign type has its own focused builder with live preview, content controls, placement settings, design presets, and optional scheduling.

That gives you a clearer setup flow than a single generic popup tool, while still keeping everything in one plugin.

Smart Product Notice

Smart Product Notice is designed for messages that should appear inside the purchase flow instead of as a popup or global bar.

Available placements include:

  • top of product page
  • before add-to-cart button
  • after add-to-cart button
  • top of cart
  • before checkout form
  • thank-you page

It works well for shipping details, trust messages, urgency copy, made-to-order information, and offer reminders.

Why use VentraPop

  • multiple campaign formats in one place
  • live preview while editing
  • schedule start and end times
  • display location controls
  • style presets and custom colors
  • coupon code and copy button support where relevant
  • practical builders aimed at common store communication needs

Getting started

After activation, go to VentraPop in your WordPress admin, choose a campaign type, add your content, adjust placement and design, then save and preview it on your site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ventrapop-coupon-popups-sale-bars-store-notices directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to VentraPop in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Create your first campaign and choose the format that fits your message.
  5. Choose your content, display settings, design options, and schedule.
  6. Save the campaign and preview it on your store.
sections.faq:
Does VentraPop work with WooCommerce?

Yes. VentraPop is a good fit for WooCommerce stores, especially when you want to show offers, shipping reminders, contact actions, or product-page messaging.

Can I create a WooCommerce coupon popup?

Yes. The Coupon Popup builder supports a headline, message, coupon code, copy button, call to action, trigger settings, scheduling, and design controls.

Can I create a sale bar or announcement bar?

Yes. You can place a bar at the top or bottom of the page for promotions, updates, holiday notices, shipping changes, or other short messages.

Can I create a free shipping bar?

Yes. The Free Shipping Bar builder is intended for shipping thresholds and similar reminders that encourage customers to keep shopping.

Can I show notices on WooCommerce product pages?

Yes. Smart Product Notice can appear at several product-page positions, including above the content area or around the add-to-cart section.

Can I show notices on cart, checkout, or thank-you pages?

Yes. Smart Product Notice also supports cart, checkout, and thank-you placements for trust, shipping, urgency, or follow-up messaging.

Can I add a sticky WhatsApp or contact button?

Yes. VentraPop includes a Sticky Contact Button builder for WhatsApp, phone, email, Telegram, Messenger, and other contact links.

Can I create floating offers?

Yes. Floating Promo Card is useful for persistent corner offers, reminders, support prompts, and similar messages that should stay visible without taking over the page.

Can I place messages manually with a shortcode?

Yes. Shortcode Message Block lets you create a reusable message and place it inside posts, pages, product descriptions, widgets, templates, or landing pages.

Does VentraPop include live preview?

Yes. VentraPop campaign builders include live preview so you can see the campaign style while editing.

Can I schedule campaigns?

Yes. VentraPop supports optional schedule start and end times. Schedule times use your WordPress site timezone.

Is VentraPop lightweight?

VentraPop is designed around focused campaign builders rather than a large marketing suite, which keeps setup and day-to-day use straightforward.

Do I need coding knowledge to use VentraPop?

No. You can create and manage campaigns from the WordPress admin without writing code.

Can I customize colors and styles?

Yes. VentraPop includes style presets and design controls for colors, typography, spacing, and campaign appearance.

Does VentraPop replace a full popup builder?

No. VentraPop focuses on a practical set of promotional and informational campaign types rather than trying to cover every advanced popup or automation use case.

  • Added schedule start and end controls using the WordPress site timezone.
  • Added display location controls.
  • Added coupon code and copy button support.
